hintConnectionText: Configure the local Modbus TCP connection to the Solinteg inverter. No cloud account or internet access is required.
hostHelp: IP address or hostname of the Solinteg inverter (or Modbus TCP/RTU gateway).
unitIdHelp: Modbus slave/unit ID of the inverter, usually 1. Valid range over Modbus TCP: 0-255 (e.g. 255 for devices that use it).
requestTimeoutHelp: Timeout for a single Modbus request, in seconds.
hintPollingText: Two independent poll loops run in parallel: the fast loop reads power/flow values (PV, grid, battery), the slow loop reads energy counters and diagnostics. Shorter intervals give more responsive data but put more load on the inverter's Modbus interface.
fastPollIntervalHelp: How often power/flow values (PV, grid, battery) are read.
slowPollIntervalHelp: How often energy counters and diagnostics are read.
hintEmsText: EMS write access lets this adapter change the inverter's working mode, charge/discharge power and limits. Leave this disabled unless you actively want to control the inverter/battery - all values are still read even when disabled.
enableEmsControlHelp: When disabled (default), all EMS-related states are read-only and writes are ignored.
